description:
In current tech forums, developers who are willingly helping fellow community members and write answers, doesnt get any economic value than just "upvotes"/"reputations" and all the economic value is being takend by Tech forum.  

Stackoverflow, is being used by millions of developers which indeed is helpful but do they share any economic value to developers who are writing answers? 

So many builders willingly contribute their time and money for the development of open source projects and they rarely get any economic value for the work they do. 

CodeCrunch is built on decentralized social graph of Lens protocol in which developers will own their questions, answers, tutorials etc with the ability to monetize their contribution to their followers.
